• Moving card: Q of Club (black)
• From: Cascade 1
• To: FreeCell 3
This is the CORRECT move because:
- Free Cell 3 is empty
- Any single card can be moved to an empty free cell
- The Q of Club is a single card move

• Moving card: 2 of Heart (red)
• From: Cascade 3
• To: Foundation Heart

- Card (Heart,2) is not the top card of Cascade pile 3
- The foundation pile is empty but the card (2 of Heart) is not an Ace

• From: Cascade 2
• To: Cascade 5

- Card (Club,4) is not the top card of Cascade pile 2
- Top card of destination pile: Q of Heart (red)
- Attempting to move: 4 of Club (black)
- This violates cascade rules:
  * Values must descend (difference is not 1)
